story_overview: After Kenji retrieves a mysterious envelope, he is found gravely injured in an alley. His friends Mei, Ryan, and Chloe rush to get him to safety, leading to a tense escape in a black sedan. Their destination appears to be The Red Lotus Kitchen, the restaurant where Mei works.
